question: The potential at a point due to a point charge is $120\text{ V}$. How will the potential change if the distance of the point from the charge is made three times? Justify your answer.

options.A: $360\,\text{V}$, because potential is directly proportional to distance
options.B: $120\,\text{V}$, because potential is independent of distance
options.C: $13.3\,\text{V}$, because potential is inversely proportional to $r^2$
